title: The Quiet Orchard
author: T. M. Almeida
blurb: Mara Amberdale, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the ice breaks on the river.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
